transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I’m having a hard time keeping things organized. Like with schoolwork and this small accessories shop I’m trying to run… supplies, due dates, receipts, assignment notes—it all kind of ends up in piles, and then I don’t know what to do first.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on a task, even when you want to pay attention?

Yeah… I do. Like in class, or if I’m watching a video for one of my business assignments, I’ll start out trying to listen, but then after a few minutes I’m thinking about charm designs or order ideas. Then I realize I missed a lot of what was said.
Did these focus and organization problems already happen when you were a child?

Yeah… I think so. My mom still has some notes from elementary school where teachers said I was out of my seat a lot, talking before they called on me, and kind of rushing through group stuff even when I knew the work.
Do you tend to delay finishing things because you want them done exactly right?
I don’t know… not really because it has to be perfect, I guess. I haven’t noticed that being the main reason.
Do these focus and organization problems also cause trouble for you in other parts of life besides school and your shop, like at home or with friends?

Yeah… it’s not just school or the shop stuff. I’ve missed some required steps for my program, and now my financial aid is kind of at risk. And with people I do shop projects with… I think they don’t rely on me as much anymore.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying, even when there isn’t an immediate problem to solve?
Um… I don’t think so. I mean, I worry about stuff when it’s happening, but I haven’t really noticed myself just worrying a lot for no reason.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Not really… I mean, I have bad days, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been depressed.
